methodology.selection: Small activity.json declares kind=lesson and a topic present in assessment inventory.
methodology.order: Complete lesson_definition, distinct contiguous explicit step positions; tutorials omitted from KP rank.
methodology.identity: e-<content_id> only for explicit example steps; use Math Academy-attributed database question/KP/topic membership or the separately resolved resolved-question-identities.json identity, cross-checked against the database KP canonical example and topic membership. No additional title/anchor inference occurs in this helper; downstream questions.json is not an input.
methodology.version: All complete source sequences retained; uniqueness requires the full canonical-example sequence, and position comparisons include both position and lesson size.
methodology.time: Prior source evidence uses max(content captured_at, capture completed_at) strictly before earliest recorded question captured_at or task completion in that assessment. These are recorded capture times, not proof of original presentation time or learner exposure.
methodology.scope: Current capture/<account>/<task> only; no legacy insertion-order inference and no database writes.
methodology.reuse: --reuse-source retains source hashes from the original extraction rather than checking current source files again.
